audited_plan.image_description: A close-up view of a silver car wheel mounted on a grey vehicle. The wheel features a five-spoke alloy rim design with a central emblem, surrounded by a black rubber tire with visible tread and sidewall texture. The wheel is positioned within the wheel well of the car body.
